title_en: Procedure for Over-Capacity Enrollment Requests (초안지) for Courses Offered by the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering, 2nd Semester of the 2026 Academic Year
summary: This notice explains how to request over-capacity enrollment (정원 외 신청, 초안지) for courses offered by the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering in the 2nd semester of 2026, including the approval criteria, priority order and courses for which requests will not be approved. Undergraduate course requests are processed collectively by the department, and students must confirm their enrollment themselves within the period.
applies_to: Students requesting over-capacity enrollment (초안지) in courses offered by the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering (전기·정보공학부) for the 2nd semester of the 2026 academic year. Students from other departments may apply only for sections that are not full as of the course registration deadline (8/11 (Tue) 16:30). Courses offered by interdisciplinary programs (연합전공) and by other departments are handled by those programs or departments.

steps: First register the course you wish to request in your Interest Courses list (관심강좌).
Go to the course registration site (http://sugang.snu.ac.kr) and open 수강신청 > 정원 외 신청 > 정원 외 신청서 작성.

In the request form, register the course by selecting it from your Interest Courses list, then enter your reason for enrollment (수강사유). State your reason specifically, and if you fall under a priority criterion, state this.

Do not contact the professors of undergraduate courses individually; undergraduate course requests are processed collectively by the department. Graduate course requests are approved by the professor in charge.

After your request is processed, confirm your enrollment (수강 확정) yourself within the period. If you do not confirm within the period, the enrollment will not be recorded and cannot be processed afterwards.
translation:
Procedure for Over-Capacity Enrollment Requests (초안지) for Courses Offered by the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering, 2nd Semester of the 2026 Academic Year

We announce the procedure for requesting and processing over-capacity enrollment (정원 외 신청, 초안지) for courses offered by the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering (전기·정보공학부) in the 2nd semester of the 2026 academic year. Please read the information below carefully before applying.

The department's approval procedure for over-capacity requests was changed as described below from the 1st semester of the 2023 academic year. Please take care not to be disadvantaged.

Undergraduate courses offered by the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering are processed collectively by the department in accordance with the department's over-capacity approval rules. Do not contact the professors in charge of undergraduate courses individually. Even if you receive individual approval by email or other means, it will not affect whether your over-capacity request is approved. Graduate courses offered by the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering are approved by the professor in charge of the course.

1. Over-capacity request: for details, refer to the attached document ([붙임]).
  a. Menu: Course registration site (http://sugang.snu.ac.kr) > Course Registration (수강신청) > Over-Capacity Request (정원 외 신청) > Write Over-Capacity Request Form (정원 외 신청서 작성)
   - Writing the request form: register the course for the over-capacity request (select it from your Interest Courses list, 관심강좌 목록) > enter your reason for enrollment (수강사유).
   ※ The course you wish to request must first be registered as an Interest Course (관심강좌).
   ※ Cancelling a request: you may cancel your request before the instructor approves it (status: Requested & In Progress, 신청&작성중).
   ※ When entering your reason for enrollment, state specifically why you wish to take the course. If you fall under a priority criterion, state this.
  b. Procedure: [Student submits request] → [Undergraduate courses are processed collectively by the department / graduate courses are approved by the professor in charge] → [Student confirms enrollment (수강 확정)]*
   (*If the student does not confirm the enrollment personally within the period, the enrollment will not be recorded and cannot be processed afterwards.)
  c. Over-capacity request and processing period: no dates are given in the text of the notice for this item. They may be shown in an image or in the attachment, which was not read.
  d. Credits you may request: your credit limit for registration − credits already registered + 6 credits.
  e. Credits you may confirm: within your credit limit for registration.

2. Criteria for processing over-capacity requests for courses offered by the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering
  a. Over-capacity approval is not on a first-come, first-served basis.
  b. Approval of undergraduate courses offered by the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering is processed by the department; graduate courses are approved by the professor in charge.
  c. Even if you receive individual approval by email or other means from the professor in charge of an undergraduate course offered by the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering, it will not affect whether your over-capacity request is approved.
  d. For an undergraduate course offered in multiple sections:
   - If some sections are not full: over-capacity requests will be rejected (not approved).
   - If all sections are full: you may submit an over-capacity request, but the number of approvals will be determined in proportion to each section's capacity.
  e. Priority order for over-capacity approval:
   - Among students expected to graduate in February 2027 or August 2027 with the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering as their primary or second major, first-time takers > first-time takers in the recommended year for the course > first-time takers in other years > students retaking the course.
   ※ However, even if you fall under a priority category, your request may not be approved depending on course operation, classroom conditions and the opinion of the professor in charge.
  f. Students from other departments may apply only for sections that are not full as of the course registration deadline (8/11 (Tue) 16:30).

3. Other matters
  a. Courses with designated prerequisites (선이수 지정 교과목):
   ※ Required reading: https://ece.snu.ac.kr/community/academics?md=v&bbsidx=57913
  b. For over-capacity requests for courses offered by interdisciplinary programs (연합전공), contact the staff of each program:
   - Interdisciplinary Program in Artificial Intelligence Semiconductor Engineering (연합전공 인공지능반도체공학) office
   - Interdisciplinary Program in Intelligent Communications (연합전공 지능형통신) office
   - Interdisciplinary Program in Artificial Intelligence (연합전공 인공지능) office
   (Contact details for these offices are given in the original notice.)
  c. For approval of courses offered by other departments, contact the department that offers the course.

4. Courses for which over-capacity requests will not be approved (rejected/not approved)
  - M2608.001500(001) Electrical and Computer Engineering Seminar 2 (전기·정보세미나 2)
  - M2608.001600(001) Electrical and Computer Engineering Seminar 3 (전기·정보세미나 3)
  - 400.019A Introduction to Electrical and Computer Engineering (전기.정보공학개론)
  - 430.502 Industrial Applications of Electrical and Electronic Technology (전기전자기술의 산업응용)
  - 430.658(003) Special Topics in System Software (시스템소프트웨어특강)
  - M2608.003400 Introduction to Medical Informatics and Medical Artificial Intelligence (의료정보와 의료인공지능 개론)

5. Inquiries: the undergraduate office of the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering (Building 301, Room 319). Contact details are given in the original notice.

Attachment: Over-Capacity Request Manual (Course Overlap Request Manual) — file "[붙임] 중복수강신청 매뉴얼(Course Overlap Request Manual).pdf" (3 MB). The content of this attachment was not read.
